## Who runs Ireland's primary schools

Every primary school in Ireland is funded by the State, but each one has a patron that sets its ethos. The maps below, from [Fianaise](https://fianaise.ie/religion/schools.html), show every mainstream primary school by patronage, using the Department of Education's list of schools.

Data from the Department of Education, [data on individual schools](https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-education/collections/data-on-individual-schools/). Maps by [Fianaise](https://fianaise.ie/religion/schools.html), where the full analysis, notes and code are published.
